title: Ladnier's fish club names and Louis's reaction
summary: Ladnier and Bechet were seriously Rosicrucian. Ladnier ran a fish club, naming himself King Fish and others Minnow and Black Bass, and Zutty thinks Louis disliked being named the Viper Fish.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But when they called that 'The House of Meditation' I mean that had to do with the Rosicrucianists thing.
I mean, I thought it was a joke name.
Lednier was very deep in that.
And he had a fish deal going. Where everybody had the name of different fish.

See, and he was the King Fish, himself. So we set a line up of things to Louis Armstrong and looked like Louis didn't care for that too much because Tommy called himself the King Fish. See, Wilbur DeParis was in it and Too Sweet was in it
He was a cat that hung around the musicians and everything like that. And he was Louis' chauffeur at one time and everything. And Peaches and Duke. He was the brother of Small Mouth Bass. (LAUGHTER).

Oh, he had a name for Wilbur DeParis, Doctor somebody. Big John was Doctor Seal because that's where you got your seal oil. And had a little trumpet player used to play with, oh, Jesus, what's that cat's name? Minnow, he was the Minnow because he was a little biddy cat, you know.

Oh, that Tommy Ladnier really had something going. But I really believe Louis didn't like that because Tommy Ladnier called himself the King Fish. And see, Louis he had a name, Louis he named the Viper. The Viper, yes. The Viper Fish.
Maybe, that maybe so. But I think it was.......

The King Fish, that was, I think that was the thing Louis didn't like. Because Tommy called himself the King Fish. And he was making Louis a new member. And we wrote to Louis and everything and we never did hear from Louis.
It was really just a sort of …….
